labels: A zip-front tracksuit jacket has matching striped trousers, with each trouser stripe continuing down the outer side of a separate leg.; 앞지퍼 체육복 재킷과 같은 배색의 바지가 짝을 이루고 줄무늬가 각각의 바지통 바깥 옆선을 따라 내려간다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A zip-front tracksuit jacket has matching striped trousers, with each trouser stripe continuing down the outer side of a separate leg.
